 Love in Disguise Episode 7 Preview: Release Date, Time & Where To Watch
 9 November 2026 by Greg Wheeler 
 Love in Disguise
 Love in Disguise is a romantic K-drama that blends mistaken identities and an unlikely romance together with a murder mystery.
 The story centers on Yoon Yi-jun, the wealthy heir to Taegang Group, which happens to be a powerful conglomerate in South Korea. Despite his good looks and successful career, Yi-jun is notoriously difficult to work with, thanks to his demanding personality.
 However, his life takes a dramatic turn when a murder occurs at the company and Yi-jun suddenly finds himself the prime suspect. With the investigation gathering momentum, former special forces officer turned detective Kang Jae-hee is tasked with getting close to him and uncovering the truth.
 To do this, Jae-hee disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yi-jun’s personal secretary. However, as the pair spend more time together, their professional relationship begins developing into something more complicated.
 If you’ve been looking forward to this K-drama, you may be curious to find out when the episodes are releasing. Well, wonder no more!
 Here is everything you need to know about episode 7 of Love in Disguise, including the release date, time and where you can watch this show.
 Where Can I Watch Love in Disguise? 
 Love in Disguise will be shown on tvN for those watching in Korea, with episodes airing every Monday and Tuesday at 8.50pm (KST). The drama is also available internationally on Amazon Prime Video, including in the UK.
 Love in Disguise Episode 7 Release Date 
 Episode 7 of Love in Disguise will release on Monday 9th November at approximately 1pm (BST) / 8am (ET), coinciding with the Korean broadcast.
 Subtitles should be available at release on Prime Video, although depending on your region, there may occasionally be a slight delay between the Korean broadcast and the episode appearing on the streaming platform so do bear that in mind!
 How Many Episodes Will Love in Disguise Have? 
 Love in Disguise is scheduled to drop with 12 episodes in total. With 2 episodes dropping every week on Monday and Tuesday, the drama should run through until Tuesday 24th November.
 With that in mind, after this episode there will be 5 more to go!
